articles.title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
articles.description: Nvidia on Monday said it is joining forces with Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM, and other tech companies to build and share open-source AI security tools. The new Open Secure AI Alliance said open tools are required to effectively defend against attacks from frontier models. The initiative is a direct response to mounting concerns over the safety […]

items.title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
items.summary: 英伟达与微软等公司组建开源AI安全联盟，旨在共享工具防御前沿模型攻击。
items.why_it_matters: 此举推动开源防御工具普及，可能降低企业应对AI安全风险的成本。

items.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
items.summary: 中国Moonshot AI发布Kimi K3模型，以低成本性能挑战美国顶尖系统。
items.why_it_matters: 该模型表现加剧中美AI竞争，或迫使美国企业调整成本与技术策略。
